subtitle: How a join can quietly multiply your rows — and your totals

steps.label: Result: 340
steps.sub: Correct for orders, wrong for customer totals

code:
-- Signup Bonus lives on Customers (100 rows)
-- After JOIN Orders: each bonus counted per order
SELECT SUM(SignupBonus)
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID
-- Result: inflated, once per order per customer
caption: Every joined row looks correct — the SUM is what's wrong.
